data.name: Vichitra - Chakra
data.detailed_description:
Vichitra, literally meaning bizarre or weird is the best word to describe the world in which the game takes place.

You play as Aditya, who belongs to a remote village in the Himalayas where his family has roots in the ancient Indian culture and mythology. After having run away from his responsibilities, he has to get back to his village to his soon to be born child, where his wife awaits him in labor. On the way, however, he meets something that changes his life forever.

​Single player narrative with a heavy influence on Game Choices and its Impact on the World.

Linear Game structure with semi-open worlds for exploration.

Realistic graphics with a fresh take and flavor on Over The Top action sequences.

Set in North India. The Player's journey from Delhi to his remote village in the Himalayas in his old car, with a few detours on train and bus rides on the way.

Face epic battles using many Physical and Supernatural weapons (both ranged and close combat) besides melee combos.

Supernatural detective elements and case solving, along with many puzzles.

Research on rich lore on local ghosts and supernatural entities to solve cases.

Use many forms of magic and face various curses and boons as you progress through the story.

Do tapasya and gain vardaan from the Gods and divine entities.

data.short_description: The year is 2009, You are a modern warrior trained in the ancient Indian art of warfare. You are on a road trip to your village in your old trusty car, but an evil has trapped you. Explore this mystical monsters-infested Himalayan region with only one main goal: earn your freedom and reach home.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains violence and blood with mature themes, such as alcohol and tobacco consumption, profanity, and walking a warrior's path to protect others and engage in combat. The killing of supernatural entities and criminals is depicted in the storylines. The protagonist unleashes his fury on the unrighteous to walk the warrior's path. The game starts with a low point, and the protagonist is shown to indulge in alcohol and tobacco consumption. As the game progresses, the protagonist reaches his full potential and leaves his bad habits behind.
